user.title: Chastity Calendar
user.description: Choose services to track and optionally enable Obedience sync. Each selected service gets its own credentials page. Connecting services requires internet access.

data.services: Services to track (select any combination, or none)

emlalock.title: Configure EmlaLock
emlalock.description: Enter your EmlaLock details. Leave them blank to configure this service later.

chaster.title: Configure Chaster
chaster.description: Enter your Chaster Developer Token. Leave it blank to configure this service later.

chastify.title: Configure Chastify
chastify.description: Enter your Chastify API key. Leave it blank to configure this service later.

obedience.title: Configure Obedience
obedience.description: Optional: connect the Obedience extension and choose the habits to increment. First grant the extension permission in Obedience, then enter its extension ID and per-user secret. Leave credentials blank to use Home Assistant-only points.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Chastity Calendar instance is supported.

init.title: Calendar and service connections
init.description: Configure calendar events, tracked services, polling, and monthly reminders. Enable Obedience to open its own separate credentials and habit setup page. Saved calendar history remains local.

data.services: Services to track (select any combination, or none)
data.monthly_notification_targets: Phone notification targets (select one or multiple phones)

emlalock.title: Configure EmlaLock
emlalock.description: Enter your EmlaLock details. Leave them blank to configure this service later.

chaster.title: Configure Chaster
chaster.description: Enter your Chaster Developer Token. Leave it blank to configure this service later.

chastify.title: Configure Chastify
chastify.description: Enter your Chastify API key. Leave it blank to configure this service later.

obedience.title: Configure Obedience
obedience.description: Grant the extension access in Obedience before entering its extension ID and per-user secret. Choose the optional habit IDs you want Home Assistant to increment.

error.invalid_options: Invalid events JSON or options. Check that months are unique values from 1 to 12 and each event has a title.
